name: TwitchMiner
description: Watches Twitch streams for you to earn channel points, catch watch streaks, follow raids and claim drops (each drop once). Configured entirely through environment variables, with an optional analytics web page. The first login needs the container console (see the first-run note in the project README).

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything the miner writes: cookies, drops database, logs and analytics.

ports.name: Analytics port
ports.description: Analytics web page port (needs Enable analytics = true).

variables.name: Twitch username
variables.description: Your Twitch username.

variables.name: Twitch password
variables.description: Only needed for the first login. Leave empty to be asked in the container console.

variables.name: Streamers
variables.description: Comma separated streamers in priority order. Per-streamer overrides: name:follow_raid=false+chat=never

variables.name: Mine followed channels
variables.description: Also mine every channel you follow on Twitch (after the streamers above).

variables.name: Enable analytics
variables.description: Serve the analytics web page. Set to false to save memory and disk.

variables.name: Analytics host
variables.description: Bind address of the analytics page inside the container; keep 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Folder inside the container for all data; must match the Data path target.

variables.name: Priority
variables.description: STREAK, DROPS, SUBSCRIBED, ORDER, POINTS_ASCENDING, POINTS_DESCENDING (comma separated).

variables.name: Priority games
variables.description: Comma separated game names to watch first for drops, e.g. Elim,Rust (more can be ticked on the analytics page). Needs DROPS in Priority.

variables.name: Drops hunt
variables.description: When a prioritised game has drops and none of your streamers is playing it, look for a live channel with drops enabled and watch it too. Needs Priority games (or games ticked on the analytics page) and DROPS in Priority.

variables.name: Drops hunt max channels
variables.description: At most this many hunted channels at a time. One that goes offline is replaced by the next one found.

variables.name: Claim drops on startup
variables.description: Claim all drops from the Twitch inventory when starting.

variables.name: Blacklist
variables.description: Comma separated streamers to skip (useful with Mine followed channels).

variables.name: Follow raids
variables.description: Follow raids for bonus points.

variables.name: Claim drops
variables.description: Watch the current game so drops can be claimed.

variables.name: Watch streak
variables.description: Prioritise streamers that just went online to catch the watch streak.

variables.name: Chat presence
variables.description: IRC chat presence: ALWAYS, NEVER, ONLINE or OFFLINE.

variables.name: Console log level
variables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

variables.name: Log time zone
variables.description: tz database name for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/London.

variables.name: Discord webhook
variables.description: Optional Discord webhook URL for notifications.

variables.name: Discord events
variables.description: Events sent to Discord (comma separated).

variables.name: Telegram chat ID
variables.description: Optional Telegram notifications: chat ID (also set the token).

variables.name: Telegram token
variables.description: Telegram bot token.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Container time zone, e.g. Europe/London.
